title: helianthemum polifolium var. strictum
intro: Helianthemum polifolium var. strictum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a perennial shrub native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and its antioxidant properties have been shown to protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum polifolium var. strictum include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
